entries.title: Fixed Stave-Basket Screw Press
entries.description: One newly authored whole static farm fruit-press appearance: two timber uprights and a thick truly bored top crossbeam carry a fixed vertical spindle with visible coarse helical thread and a transverse wood handle. A separate round pressure platen lies inside a genuinely open slatted stave basket held by two full annular hoops. Below it a shallow collector floor, partial raised rim and connected open U spout form a visible unfilled tray on the grounded timber base. Complete new construction, not a resized closed barrel, nested textile basket, flat-jaw bench vise or lever citrus press. No old visible meshes are imported or extracted. Closed editable meshes and three opaque constant PBR materials; small fixed embedded junctions. Metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal bounds centre, base underside Z0. Empty static game-art only: no fruit, liquid, pressing stroke, thread engagement, pressure, juice yield, food contact/hygiene, manufacture, stability or real-equipment safety certification.

entries.title: Mirror and Sample Fitting Corner
entries.description: One static fitting-preparation corner from the original tailoring scene program. A complete supported hollow long-sleeve lapel sample, a complete fixed full-length floor mirror, and a complete rail with its original hooked shoulder hanger form three separate display stations with an empty area in front of the mirror. All three existing asset IDs preserve every whole mesh, original local POSITION/NORMAL payload, material and internal hierarchy. Only unit-scale whole-instance translations and one finite scene-only floor are new. One scene and zero new independent models. No person, worn garment, body-size fit, cloth motion, changing enclosure, privacy guarantee, ergonomics, access or safety certification. The mirror remains the original ordinary metallic-roughness PBR surface; no runtime planar-reflection or optical accuracy claim.

entries.title: Three-Piece Nested-Channel Mine Arch Support
entries.description: One newly authored complete static mine-arch support module: two whole curved open U-channel legs on flat ground plates and one genuinely narrower open-channel crown nested into their grooves over two finite lap zones. Four front bridge straps with eight fixed hex-head appearances mark the actual lap locations. The crown back web meets the leg channel back-web plane; side clearances remain real. Every channel is a complete closed thick material shell around a truly open front groove, not a solid arch painted with lines or a reused stone arch with different colors. All seventeen component meshes newly authored with mature polygon-sweep primitives. The passage has no threshold, wall, rock lining or hidden blocker. Static art only: no moving adjustment, sliding mechanism, excavation, tunnel installation, structural strength, rock-load resistance, bolt tightening or mining safety claim.
